allowed_root.description: Optional single allowed commitment-tree root (stub window).

mock_verify.description: When true, proof verify is mocked (lab / ict film). Production: false + zk-api.

zkid.description: Circuit id registered in x/wasm for `proof_instance_verify`. Optional until circuit lands.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
